summary: Run cli_parse with the native parser on ip addr show; it needs gathered facts for ansible_distribution or an explicit template_path, and yields per-interface data like IP, mask, MTU and state.
questions: Why can't cli_parse find my Linux template?
Do I need gather_facts for cli_parse on Linux?

answer_card.title: Parse Linux output with cli_parse
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    command: ip addr show
    parser:
      name: ansible.netcommon.native
    set_fact: interfaces
```
The template is located using `ansible_distribution`, so gather facts first, or set `parser.template_path`.
